arguments.command:
python3 - << 'PY'
import statistics

# Original nominal values (in millions)
nominal_1992 = 144724
nominal_1993 = 158633
nominal_1994 = 166731

# CPI-U values from the provided table
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars: Real = Nominal × (CPI_1994 / CPI_source)
adj_1992 = nominal_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adj_1993 = nominal_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adj_1994 = nominal_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # This equals nominal since we're adjusting to 1994

print(f"1992 adjusted: {adj_1992}")
print(f"1993 adjusted: {adj_1993}")
print(f"1994 adjusted: {adj_1994}")

# Create the list of adjusted values
adjusted_values = [adj_1992, adj_1993, adj_1994]
print(f"\nAdjusted values: {adjusted_values}")

# Calculate sample mean
mean_adj = statistics.mean(adjusted_values)
print(f"Mean: {mean_adj}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1)
stdev_adj = statistics.stdev(adjusted_values)
print(f"Stdev (sample): {stdev_adj}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adj_1994 - mean_adj) / stdev_adj
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score}")

# Round to two decimal places
z_score_rounded = round(z_score, 2)
print(f"Z-score rounded: {z_score_rounded}")
PY
